description: Generate a professional visual (diagram, infographic, illustration) from text using Napkin AI. ASYNC WORKFLOW: 1) Call napkin_generate_visual → returns request_id. 2) Call napkin_check_status(request_id) repeatedly every 3-5 seconds. 3) Continue polling until status is "completed" or "failed". 4) When completed, get file URLs from generated_files array. 5) Optionally call napkin_download_visual to save files to disk. VISUAL QUERIES: "mindmap", "timeline", "flowchart", "comparison", "hierarchy", "process", "cycle", "matrix", "funnel", "pyramid". DO NOT assume generation is complete immediately — you MUST poll napkin_check_status.

color_mode.description: Color scheme. "both" generates light and dark versions.

content.description: The text content to visualize. Max 100,000 bytes.

context.description: Additional context to help generate better visuals (not shown in output)

format.description: Output format: svg (default), png, or ppt

sort_strategy.description: How to sort visual layout options

style_id.description: Style identifier from Napkin — call napkin_list_styles to browse the 15 built-in styles

transparent_background.description: Use transparent background instead of white/dark

visual_id.description: Regenerate using a specific visual layout ID

visual_ids.description: Regenerate using multiple visual layout IDs

visual_queries.description: Multiple visual types (one visual per query)

name: napkin_generate_visual
